gaps_and_uncertainty.detail: Assigned text includes Learn View, Link Audio, Splice and other newer Live 12 features but gives no exact minor-version matrix. Runtime asks to verify installed build and feature presence; no availability in all Live 12 builds is claimed. Max for Live Suite/Standard and macOS-only M4A/Audio Units distinctions are retained.

5.5.2 describes new presets defaulting to Current Project; other passages describe User Library storage/Save Preset behavior. Runtime uses explicit drag destinations and verification instead of asserting one universal default.
Single clip export creates .alc; multi-selected Session clips create a new Set. One-at-a-time clip/preset wording is not misapplied to the explicit new-Set workflow.

Every extracted page was read; figures/screenshots were not rendered. No essential diagram-only relationship was identified. Exact spatial placement beyond text-supported control descriptions is not inferred.

Splice catalog size is approximate; authorization, ownership, available Packs, service connectivity and current provider behavior were not checked. No upload, account mutation or download was performed.

Deletion, destructive external sample editing, provider uploads/capture and redistribution procedures are excluded. Their risk or applicability is retained where operationally necessary, with section-specific exclusions.
No extension tools, endpoint names, or blanket UI-automation equivalence are asserted. The reference supplies UI procedures only.
No Live UI actions, audio listening, device tests, exports, archive restores, network effects or filesystem media changes were performed.
